findings.title: canManage() grants manage from view-only permission
findings.body: GroupPermissionsV2.canManage() evaluates hasPermission(null, VIEW, MANAGE). Any caller with only the view scope on the all-groups resource therefore passes canManage(), and can create/update/delete groups, add children and map roles. Global manage must require only MANAGE, like canManage(GroupModel) does on line 79.

findings.title: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission uses resource ID instead of resource name
findings.body: AdminPermissionsSchema stores per-group resources with name equal to the group ID. hasPermission(String groupId) looks up via resourceStore.findByName(server, groupId) and the granted set is expected to contain group IDs. The loop passes groupResource.getId() (internal authz UUID) to hasPermission and adds getId() to the result. Lookup by UUID misses, falls back to the all-groups resource, and returns UUIDs instead of group IDs, so user search filtering by UserModel.GROUPS gets wrong/empty values and leaks or hides users.

findings.title: Missing null check on all-groups type resource causes NPE
findings.body: hasPermission() falls back to AdminPermissionsSchema.SCHEMA.getResourceTypeResource() which can return null when the schema is not supported or the type resource does not exist, then immediately calls policyStore.findByResource(server, resource). A null resource causes NullPointerException, breaking canView/canManage evaluation for admins without a per-group resource.
